_: See scripts/check-harness-stubs.ts. Every `ctx.internals` member the contract harness stubs, with the category that says WHICH question it answers. A member not listed here throws when a test reaches it.

categories.inert-by-nature: A stub returning `undefined` is a fair answer. The member does work that is not what the test is about, and its absence cannot make a guard pass.
categories.fails-closed-if-stubbed: The stub's `undefined` reads as 'no' at the call site, so a route becomes unreachable rather than unguarded. Visible when it happens — a route that always 403s gets noticed — but it hides the allow path, which is how the editor gate went untested in both directions.
categories.fails-open-if-stubbed: The member REFUSES BY THROWING, so a stub that resolves silently means allowed. A test written to prove the refusal passes with the guard deleted. Nothing may sit here: this category exists so the word is available when triaging a new member, and an entry in it is a bug to fix, not a state to record.
